question: What is the molecular formula for hydrochloric acid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HCl.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **molecular formula for hydrochloric acid** is** HCl.**
 
• **Properties of Hydrochloric Acid:**__
 __
 
• Strongly acidic
 
• Viscous and colourless
 
• Highly corrosive acid
 
• Pungent smell
 
• Properties dependent upon concentration - Melting and boiling point, pH, and density
 
 
 
• **Uses of HCl:**__
 
 
• Used in rubber and textile industries.
 
• Production of chlorides, fertilizers, dye, and organic compounds Refining of metals.
 
• Regulate pH of solutions.
 
• Unblock pores in oil wells.
